notes.title: The First Anniversary of Nine Sols!
notes.notes:
Hi, this is Red Candle Games.

Today marks the [b]first anniversary[/b] of [i]Nine Sols[/i].  Looking back over the past 365 days, we’ve celebrated some unforgettable milestones together:

- [b]2024 / 05 / 29[/b] [i]Nine Sols[/i] launched
- [b]2024 / 07 / 12[/b] Steam reviews topped 6,000, earning an [b]“Overwhelmingly Positive”[/b] rating
- [b]2024 / 07 / 21[/b] Japan [b]BitSummit[/b] — [i]International Award[/i] winner
- [b]2024 / 08 / 22[/b] Germany [b]Gamescom[/b] — [i]Best Audio[/i] nominee
- [b]2024 / 11 / 26[/b] Console release + language support expanded to [b]14[/b]
- [b]2024 / 12 / 20[/b] [b]Steam Awards[/b] — [i]Outstanding Visual Style[/i] nominee
- [b]2025 / 01 / 10[/b] Hosted the [i]Nine Sols[/i] fan art contest
- [b]2025 / 02 / 05[/b] [b]IGF Awards[/b] — [i]Excellence in Visual[/i] Art finalist
- [b]2025 / 03 / 15[/b] Japan [b]Famitsu Dengeki Game Awards[/b] — [i]Indie Game Grand Prize[/i] winner
- [b]2025 / 04 / 23[/b] Release of the manga [i]Nine Sols – The Way of Lear: Prelude[/i]
- [b]2025 / 05 / 02[/b] [b]Brazil Gamescom LATAM[/b]  — [i]Best Game[/i] winner

As of today, [i]Nine Sols[/i] has sold [b]over 800,000 copies[/b] across all platforms.

It’s been [b]Red Candle’s own odyssey[/b], six years, countless challenges, and now a sunlit horizon.

Thank you for walking this road with us, and for the chance to cross paths on the Way. ☀️🙏

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42192836/76327c373c0187e6c6f7bc8254648668863ed317.png[/img]

notes.title: Nine Sols Digital Artbook Release
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we are Red Candle Games.

We’re excited to announce that the [b]Nine Sols Digital Artbook[/b] is now officially available! If you’re interested in the world and visual design of *Nine Sols*, we warmly invite you to take a look.

[i]Nine Sols[/i] is an original title by Red Candle Games, meticulously crafted over five years. This artbook offers a glimpse into the thoughts and philosophies that shaped its creation, showcasing the collective effort and passion of our entire art and design team.

The digital artbook contains [b]416 pages of content[/b] (presented as 208 pages in a horizontal double-page PDF layout), featuring a curated collection of core visual materials from the development of [i]Nine Sols[/i].

❗ [b]NOTE:[/b] [u]The Nine Sols Digital Art Book on Steam can only be accessed by accounts that own the Steam version of the game.[/u]

🔗[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3362590/Nine_Sols_Digital_Art_Book/][b] Nine Sols Digital Artbook page[/b][/url]

notes.title: Nine Sols Prequel Manga Revealed - Nine Sols: The Way of Lear – Prelude
notes.notes:
Hi, this is Red Candle Games.
    
When we were working on [i]Nine Sols[/i], our team had many ideas for the story of Lear, but due to time constraints and other factors, we weren't able to include everything.

However, a year ago, by chance, we established a partnership with MOJOIN, and we were fortunate enough to meet the amazing artist, Yang Chi-Cheng. As a result, what was once an extravagant idea for us gradually became a reality through the collective efforts of everyone involved, especially with the invaluable contributions of Mr. Yang. This allowed the story of Lear and the world of Penglai to be further extended.
    
Today, we are excited to share [i]Nine Sols - The Way of Lear: Prelude[/i] with you, and we hope you enjoy it!
____________________
    
[b]Presented by MOJOIN.[/b]
    
From acclaimed game studio [b]Red Candle Games[/b] and renowned manga artist [b]Yang Chi-Cheng[/b] comes the official prequel to [i]Nine Sols[/i]:
    
[b]Nine Sols: The Way of Lear – Prologue.[/b]
    
Ages ago, long before the events of *Nine Sols*, two Solarians forever altered the course of Penglai’s history.
    
One, a visionary [b]Fangshi[/b].
The other, a king among kings.
Bound by fate, torn by belief—their unlikely bond would spiral into a clash of destiny.
    
[b]Uncover the hidden past. Witness the origin of the [i]Nine Sols[/i] saga![/b]
    
[b]✴︎ Click here to start reading![/b]
[list]

[*] CH: https://mojoin.tw/Vav7j
[*] JP: https://mojoin.tw/2lV09
[/list]
    
🎮 Follow the manga for a chance to win a game code, find more details on the @mojoin_tw platform.

notes.title: Nine Sols Nominated for 2024 Steam Award: Outstanding Visual Style
notes.notes:
It’s an incredible honor to announce that, among many remarkable contenders, [b]Nine Sols[/b] has earned a nomination for the [b]2024 Steam Outstanding Visual Style Award[/b]! 🏆

If you’ve enjoyed the hand-drawn art, frame-by-frame animation, and distinctive Taopunk aesthetics we’ve poured our hearts into, we humbly ask for your vote on Steam before [b]December 31st at 10 AM Pacific Time[/b]. Your support means the world to our team. 🗳️🙏

This recognition already feels like a major milestone, and we’re truly grateful for all the encouragement that has helped Nine Sols reach a global audience in 2024. We hope you’re enjoying the holiday season, and we look forward to bringing you even more exciting news and stories in the months ahead! ☯️

notes.title: Nominate Nine Sols for the "Game of the Year" in The Steam Awards 2024
notes.notes:
It's hard to believe it's only been 6 months since the release of Nine Sols, and our Taopunk action platformer has already accumulated almost 15,000 overwhelmingly positive reviews on Steam. This is a significant milestone, but more importantly, we couldn't have done it without you—our players worldwide. Thank you all for your incredible support!

Steam has just launched its annual vote for games on the platform, with one of the categories being "Game of the Year." While we haven't had much spotlight in major awards this year, and it might be a bit bold for us to even think about winning, Nine Sols is a title we've spent over 5 years perfecting every aspect of. We truly believe it's a unique and fun game. So if you've enjoyed the Taopunk experience, we'd be honored if you considered nominating Nine Sols for the Game of the Year Award. 🙏

Again, thank you all for reading this and for your continuous support!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42192836/b160c7a1d97831042ed970171dd0e1c1748fb70a.png[/img]

Since the demo was released, we've noticed that players worldwide had put countless hours into challenging The Red Centaur. As developers of the game, we are still in awe, witnessing gamers utilizing techniques that we didn't realize existed and keep on breaking the time records! So we've decided to share these extraordinary highlights with our audience.

For players who've never played the demo, this gameplay footage could give you a glimpse of Nine Sols, an action platformer that focuses on Sekiro-like deflection-based combat, meticulously hand-drawn animations, and a unique "Taopunk" world setting. And if you're confident with your gaming skills, we invite you to come and claim your spot on the leaderboard!

On a side note, Nine Sols's crowdfunding campaign will end in less than two weeks. We're only a step away from reaching the 12 mil NTD (Alternate Ending) stretch goal. Please share the news if you like what we're doing with Nine Sols; this unique "Taopunk" action platformer wouldn't be able to take shape and complete on time without your help. Thanks, and we hope you have a fantastic Steam Next Fest!
